implementation_basis: XKV heterogeneous LCF-X learned layer-axis map
explicit_implementation_choices: C2C pre-RMSNorm/GELU/residual FFN x2; architecture reference parameter counts checked by tests
LCF-X first pool uses one shared key-derived attention distribution for K and V; second pool similarly
LCF-X layer map is bias-free linear initialized to last_aligned; only unequal depths have this map
LCF-X deterministic ID-seeded 5+5 evidence partition; full paragraphs only; overlength records explicitly excluded
Physical microbatch=1, with paper logical-microbatch token weighting and effective batch preserved
Validation split excludes question/conversation duplicates across train/validation; exact reserved-test matches removed
No author training weights used; communication modules train from initialization

compute.gpu: auto: any idle GPU with sufficient memory
compute.concurrency: One independent experiment per available GPU; all physical GPUs eligible
compute.insufficient_memory: wait; do not stop other jobs
